summary: Verified the upgraded Retention 'Protect' workspace (per-deal page /retention/:dealId) + real email send end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 new tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_retention_workspace.py covering GET /api/retention/deal/{deal_id} (auth, shape, 404, cross-org 404, plays reflected after create) and POST /api/retention/send-email (auth, missing/invalid recipient, missing subject/body, well-formed reachable → 502 in preview as expected). Frontend Playwright loop verified: /churn → Protect button (protect-btn-0) → navigates to /retention/deal_0a267a265bb5 (Tyrell Corp Outreach, $95k). Old protect-dialog and action-* testids are removed. Workspace-page renders with ws-deal-name, ws-revenue-protected ($0 initial), risk badge, 4 signal tiles, 4 tabs. Support flow: generate-support → draft-support → save-support → ws-revenue-protected jumped $0 → $95,000, activity list shows 'saved'. Outreach flow: generate-outreach → email-to/subject/body + send/copy/regenerate rendered, empty recipient triggers 'Enter a valid recipient email' toast (no crash), valid recipient triggers actual send attempt (502 in preview, as expected — no crash). back-to-churn returns to /churn.

issues: Persistent React hydration/DOM-nesting warnings still present in console (carried over from iteration 46, unrelated to this iteration's changes): '<th> cannot be a child of <span>', '<span> cannot be a child of <tr>/<tbody>', '<td> cannot be a child of <span>' — caused by the emergent x-source instrumentation wrapping <th>/<tr>/<td> inside .map() with <span data-ve-dynamic style='display:contents'>. Non-functional but pollutes console.

action_items: (Optional carry-over) Fix cohort-table hydration warnings in ChurnRetention.js (introduced by dynamic instrumentation on <th>/<tr>/<td> mapped rows/cells).

(Optional) The Outreach 'send-email' toast on success/failure auto-dismisses in ~4s — consider persisting the error toast longer so users notice 502 delivery failures. (Not blocking; a 502 was correctly returned by backend when Resend delivery fails in preview.)
critical_code_review_comments: retention.py is clean and cohesive: GET /retention/deal/{deal_id} scoped via org_filter; unknown deal correctly 404s (both nonexistent + cross-org). _deal_risk_context() cleanly derives id/deal_id/risk_level/engagement_score/days_inactive from a deal doc — good defensive design.

send-email validation is correct: rejects missing/empty/invalid recipient and missing subject/body (400). Correctly returns 503 when RESEND_API_KEY is absent and 502 on Resend send failure. The play status → 'in_progress' transition on successful send is guarded by result.get('sent'), so it will not fire on 502/503.

RetentionWorkspace.js has all required data-testids and cleanly separates renderOutreach() (email compose) from renderGenericTool() (offer/support/workflow). No _id serialization risk since backend excludes it. Nice UX: Revenue Protected refreshes via load() after every generate/updatePlay/sendEmail.

ChurnRetention.js correctly REMOVED the old protect-dialog and all action-* testids; the Protect button now navigates via react-router with state fallback. retention-plays-card still renders and reflects plays created from the workspace (verified — Revenue Protected jumped $0→$95k after saving).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids verified, full protect→workspace→support→save loop + outreach validation flow)
